items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I admired his playing... Barney's my man on clarinet... I didn't know too many of the members of the band.

ctx.x: Yeah, I admired his playing. I still listen at it. I still admire it. He had a real clarinet tone, you know what I mean? And Barney... Barney's my man on clarinet. Yeah, I like Barney very much.
And you must have heard Simeon?
